Hello,

   Good afternoon noon. I have 2 question. Any word on when the B30 will be shipped? Also can someone please check on the warranty replacement request I placed for the BSB NerdOctaxe last week. Have not received any update on the request

VR James Y. Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer
Note to the team: I'll pull up the order and the RMA before replying.
Handed to the team · RMA approval is not mine to give and has been sitting unsigned for over a week.

Hi James,

Thanks for your patience, and I'm sorry to be walking back the date I gave you.

On the B30: batch 1 is no longer on track for October 15. The shipment is booked with the carrier and waiting for pickup at the factory, and it is now expected at our US warehouse in mid November. Your order is covered by that batch, and your unit ships out to (address hidden) once it is checked in. I will not quote you a day for that until the boxes are physically scanned in, but you will get tracking at this address the moment the label is made. You can watch that shipment move here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On the NerdOctaxe: I'm sorry, the approval still has not been signed off, and you should not have had to ask this many times. Hal's findings and your serial number are on the case, so nothing further is needed from you. I have put it straight in front of JD and Georges this morning, with your previous chases attached. The team is offline right now and picks this up today at 10am Eastern, and the answer, with the return label, comes to this email address.

If you want to push the RMA along faster, JD is on our Discord most days at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf as @nullhashrate. Either way I'll keep following it here.

Thanks for sticking with us, James.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

What information should I give JD to speed up my RMA?

VR James Y. Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer

Hi James,

Short answer: nothing, really. Everything JD needs is already on your case.

What he has is the fault Hal confirmed with you, the serial number of the NerdOctaxe, and the order it was bought on. That is the whole file for an approval, so you are not waiting on anything from your side.

If you want to hand him something that makes it a two minute decision rather than a read through, these four help: a short phone video showing the unit powering up and throwing the fault, a clear photo of the serial label on the underside, the firmware version the dashboard reports, and one line confirming the unit was never overclocked or modified, since that is the first thing checked on any warranty claim. Mentioning which power supply you were running it on is useful too.

On Discord he is @nullhashrate at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, and you can post the video and photo straight into the server, which is faster than anything by mail. Otherwise the approval sits with the team and they pick it up Monday at 10am Eastern, with the answer and the return label coming to this address.

Thanks, James, I'll keep an eye on it from here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I don't know the original order number, I bought it 2nd hand New in box at a charity event auction

VR James Y. Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer
Handed to the team · Warranty on a second-hand unit with no proof of purchase is a decision only a pe

Hi James,

Thanks for telling me, that explains why nothing came up under your email, and it is not a problem to have said so.

A unit bought second hand sits outside the normal warranty route, because our cover runs with the original purchase and there is no order here to tie it to. I am not going to tell you no on my own, though. I have put the whole case in front of JD and Georges with Hal's findings, the serial number and the fact that it came new in box from a charity auction, and asked them to decide whether we can cover it anyway. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern and the answer comes to this email address. Please don't post it anywhere until you hear from them.

Two things that will help them say yes. The serial number lets us see whether it is a unit we sold and roughly when, so if you can send a clear photo of the serial label that is worth a lot. Anything the seller gave you at the auction, even a note or a lot listing, is also useful.

Separately, the fault itself may still be fixable. JD is on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf as @nullhashrate and he is good at talking these through, so a short video of the unit booting and throwing the fault, posted there, costs you nothing either way.

Your B30 is unaffected by any of this and still sits with batch 1.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Here is the serial number and a picture of the fault. The video will not load up as an attachment. So when I send it to JD should I attach any ID I need to send for the video

VR James Y. Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer

Hi James,

Got both, thanks. The serial reads (number hidden) on a NerdQaxe 12T, and the photo shows the overheating screen exactly as Hal described it. I have added both to your case, so JD will have them in front of him in the morning.

On the video, no ID of any kind. We never ask for a passport, a military ID, a driving licence or anything like that, and you should not send one to anyone who claims to be us. All JD needs with the video is your name as it appears in this thread and the serial above, so he can tie it to the right case. The video itself is enough.

Yahoo tends to choke on anything over about 25 MB, which is why it would not attach. Dropping it in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and mentioning @nullhashrate is the easiest route, and a 15 or 20 second clip of the unit booting and hitting that screen is plenty. If you would rather not use Discord, a shorter clip, or one recorded at lower resolution, will usually go through by mail.

Keep it unplugged until you hear back. The decision on cover sits with JD and Georges and they pick it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, with the answer coming to this address.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Can I send the video right to JD?

Yahoo Mail: Search, Organize, Conquer

Hi James,

Yes. Discord is the direct line to him: join at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post the clip in the server and mention @nullhashrate, and it lands with him personally. He shows up there as JD with the Admin role, so you will know you have the right person.

I don't give out individual mailboxes, so the other route is simply to reply here with the clip attached, and I put it straight on your case where JD reads it. Either way it reaches him, Discord is just faster and handles large files better than Yahoo does.

Add the serial (number hidden) with the clip so he can match it without hunting.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
